explicitExclusions.qualification: Historical terminal 3I only. Its original schema lacks quiet_acknowledged and retains historical publication_started=true alongside publication_completed=true. The exact snapshot is retained in policy.historicalTerminalOutsideCurrentLanes; no signals were invented or status rewritten. Active successor lanes are separately monitored.

launcherContractReview: Policy schema, shared lock path, unique safe lane names and direct shared-status parent paths match the frozen launcher.
The launcher requires all five keys to be present with exact types and values; completed mode does not bypass activity flags.
Each terminal mode has a nonempty terminalStatement and fingerprinted completionEvidence, all 13 retained policy evidence records match the files read.
Current statuses are reread under exclusive flock before measurement and after child completion; raw bytes are retained even when validation fails.
Fresh quiet was initially pending for 5B and is now explicitly satisfied. The launcher must still check the live statuses at launch and completion.
predeclarationEvidence and acknowledgedAt are descriptive policy bindings; explicit_quiet validation uses the actual status signals captured by the launcher, not a substituted old snapshot.

schemaCautions: Use the full compressed Facet source parity report, not its diagnostic or execution receipt.

Published predecessor must expose actual version/deployment and match declared Site 91 and commit 5659ddc9420c7624df4865f0afc628782296a186; Site 90 equivalence does not satisfy exact declared publication identity.
LKEY remains a separate partial-preservation qualification with rawCampaignStatus=failed and gameTargetCompleted=false; it does not become a strict completed case.
Integrity must be the native-delivery-integrity.v1 receipt with nativeSourceDigest and actual bound receipts; the finalizer refuses missing or changed inputs.
Owner contract and static preflight precede readiness, which precedes the future window. Existing readiness or window outputs are not overwritten.
Strict regression verification scales as 17 checks per declared case; 10 current strict cases mean 170 checks. Public final parity may use frozen replay without asserting an additional live game run.

costDecisionRule: The predeclared global median increase must remain strictly below 10% separately for STCK and SMLP; phase overruns remain visible diagnostics and are not independent vetoes. No timing result or acceptance outcome is asserted by this review.
remainingQualification: Cooperative declared project lanes and the shared flock are reviewed. This does not certify unrelated uninstrumented host processes. No additional fresh-quiet blocker was identified at the observed state; final launch-time verification remains mandatory.
